# nemau load-balancer pool add-monitor

Add a health monitor to a pool.

UDP pools accept only UDP_CONNECT: failures on a UDP pool are detected
passively, and the API does not offer an active probe it would not perform.

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer pool add-monitor <pool-id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --delay int               interval between two probes, in seconds (required)
      --expected-codes string   expected HTTP codes, for example 200-299
      --http-method string      HTTP method for the probe
      --max-retries int         consecutive failures before taking the backend out (required)
      --probe-timeout int       timeout for one probe, in seconds (required)
      --type string             type: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP_CONNECT (required)
      --url-path string         path to probe
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
